conventional_commit: fix(release): gate linux-only capture code and make release workflows honest
root_cause: chronos-native used Linux-only nix ptrace APIs with no target_os gating, so every tagged release failed the macOS leg (Release workflow 0 successes in its last 100 runs) and the Docker workflow failed at login when repo secrets are absent (0 successes in its last N runs).
fix_summary: ptrace_tracer keeps a linux-only implementation plus field/variant-identical bridge stubs for PtraceConfig and PtraceEvent; capture_runner, native_adapter and int3_injector moved their bodies into linux-only imp modules; probe_backend gates the three run_probe_loop fns and the bodies of start_probe/attach_probe/advance/step, failing closed with TraceError::UnsupportedOperation off Linux; lib.rs re-exports conditionally; release.yml fails loud when the binary is missing and uses fail-fast false; docker.yml skips the publish path with a workflow notice when DOCKERHUB secrets are absent.

verification.result: 0 errors, 0 warnings (exact binary built by the macOS CI leg)
both workflows parse, steps structurally valid

verification.argv: shellcheck --severity=warning on the two inline workflow shell bodies
verification.result: clean; docker credential guard simulated on both branches (configured and not configured)

scope_non_goals: no macOS support claim: non-Linux callers fail closed with TraceError::UnsupportedOperation
known_unknowns: real macOS runner execution pending until push; local cross-check cannot run ring/blake3 native build scripts for unrelated workspace crates (local cross-cc artifact, documented, not a product defect)
supersede_reason: the local release route requires the cycle to point at trunk main; the original cycle was declared with the default feat/ branch. Implementation and verification artifacts carried over unchanged: same tree, same verified HEAD 3d935b6a, plus the version lockstep bump 5842075e.
